name: SENTINEL water anomaly detector (Model C, predictive residual)
intended_use: Advisory early warning of physical-process inconsistencies in C-Town-style water telemetry for SENTINEL investigation prioritisation and digital-twin display.
threshold_calibration: dataset03 2014-10-20..2015-01-06 normal holdout, <= 1 alert episode / 7 days, 2 h persistence, episodes merged across <= 3 h gaps
inputs: 36 informative BATADAL channels at t-1, t-2; pump/valve status and flow at t; hour of day
outputs: residual |z| for 7 tank levels + 12 junction pressures; hourly score = max
limitations: One simulated network (C-Town) and 7 attacks; not evidence for real utilities or other sectors
Anomaly location can be downstream of the attacked component when sensors are replayed (attack 4)
Coverage inside long attacks is partial (attack 7: 36/110 hours, 18 h gap)
Score jumps about 1 h before documented attack starts (likely timestamp convention, unverified)
Raw scores are heavy-tailed; use display_score_0_100 or the log scale for presentation
display_transform: display = 100*r/(1+r), r = raw/threshold (50 at threshold); alerts use raw score
severity_bands: low >=1x, medium >=3x, high >=10x threshold (statistical deviation, not impact)
